theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) n), ∫⁻ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (n + 1), R'.carrier = (fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ R.carrier) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), R'.mult (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = R.mult x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ (t : ℝ) (α : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1)) (β : Covector (Euclid N) n), (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid N, β v = α (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → R'.orient (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) α = R.orient x β
